name: الانحراف التشغيلي

patient.diagnosis: Metastatic colorectal cancer, restaging after FOLFOX
patient.note: oxaliplatin is a platinum compound. MOH-CM-NEPHROTOXIC names 'platins' explicitly.

expected_checks.detail: CTDIvol 18.0 > 14 and DLP 900 > 706 for adult abdomen & pelvis. Binding on providers by Royal Decree 60057 approving Health Council Resolution 3/88.
eGFR 27.7 < 30 and not on maintenance dialysis. Patient is eligible for prophylaxis, none ordered. CA-AKI risk in this band is approximately 30%.
Category II: eGFR < 30 with metformin. Must be stopped at or before the exam and suspended 48 hours, not reinstituted until renal function normalises.
Active platinum chemotherapy plus NSAID at eGFR < 30. Protocol advises withholding non-essential nephrotoxic agents 24-48h before and 48h after.

expected_action: Withhold the Modality Worklist entry; the device API returns 403 Policy Violation. Present the corrected protocol below. Release requires a named consultant override, recorded in the audit trail. Override remains available because MOH-CM-CKD45 makes stage 4-5 CKD a relative, not absolute, contraindication.

safe_alternative.prophylaxis: Isotonic saline prophylaxis per MOH protocol prior to and after the study
safe_alternative.metformin: Hold metformin at the exam and for 48 hours; reassess renal function before restarting
safe_alternative.consider: Non-contrast CT or MRI if the clinical question permits
safe_alternative.provenance: Dose values placed under the national DRL. Contrast volume reduced toward routine practice, NOT presented as a regulatory limit - no Saudi or ACR text sets an eGFR-based volume ceiling.
